description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity (SlidingFragments) that demonstrates fragment animations involving scaling, rotation, and overlay effects for a sliding transition between two fragments (ImageFragment and TextFragment) in an embedded UI. It manages fragment transactions and animations for a sliding UI feature with associated UI interactions.

classes.name: SlidingFragments
classes.description: An Android Activity managing fragment animations for sliding in/out with overlay effects, including callback interfaces and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up fragment references, view elements, and click listeners.

methods.name: switchFragments
methods.description: Toggles between showing and hiding the text fragment with animated transitions, managing fragment transactions and animation status.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Handles back stack changes to trigger sliding animation when the fragment backstack is popped.

methods.name: slideBack
methods.description: Animates the image fragment into the background, scaling, rotating, and adding a semi-transparent overlay.

methods.name: slideForward
methods.description: Animates the image fragment into the foreground, scaling, rotating back, and removing overlay.

methods.name: onAnimationEnd
methods.description: Callback to reset the animation progress flag after animations complete.
